name: FlatEntries
description: Characterization fixture: a ledger of dated item records with one flat row per entry.

contains_no_content_of_requested_type.description: Set to true if the input contains no records. Otherwise, set to false.

record_id.description: The record heading as written, such as 'Record 001'.

item.description: The item named in the record.

quantity.description: The quantity stated in the record. Use null if not stated.

price.description: The price stated in the record. Use null if not stated.

date.description: The date of the record as written. Use null if not stated.

source_page.description: The page on which the record appears. Use null if not identifiable.

notes.description: Remarks about the record. Use null if there are none.
